description: Run one specific agent-readiness check against a site (e.g. 'a2a-agent-card', 'llms-txt', 'mcp-server-card', 'x402'). Use this for targeted validation after making a fix or when debugging one signal; use scan_site for the complete ASO Score and get_fix_plan for a prioritized remediation roadmap. Use list_checks first when you need valid check ids. Returns status, evidence, and a fix recommendation, and omits raw remote artifacts by default.

check_id.description: Lowercase check slug from list_checks, e.g. 'a2a-agent-card', 'llms-txt', 'mcp-server-card', or 'x402'.

url.description: Website URL or domain to scan, e.g. https://example.com or example.com

name: check_signal
title: Run a single agent-readiness check
